services.name: Dolphin & Manatee Watch Cruise
services.desc: Duration 2 hours About Come and join LeBarge and a Sarasota Bay Explorers trained marine biologist on this two hour cruise and learn about the lifestyle and behavior of our local population of over 170 bottlenose dolphins, as well as manatees (in season). The guide will explain their hunting techniques, physical adaptations and social hierarchy. Also learn of the effects brought on by humankind and what is being done to protect this magnificent mammal. Sarasota Bay is the ideal location to observe these intelligent marine mammals.
